john romney.name: John Romney
john romney.origin: John Romney was the uncle of Gale Romney, an heiress who stood to inherit a large fortune when she turned 18. Since he was the next-in-line for the inheritance, Romney tried to arrange her death in various "accidents". He eventually arranged her kidnapping by a criminal gang, but she was rescued by the Texas Kid. John tried to steal the Kid's horse to escape, but it threw him off its back.

john ronald reuel tolkien.name: John Ronald Reuel Tolkien
john ronald reuel tolkien.origin: John Ronald Reuel Tolkien, better known as J. R. R. Tolkien, was an English writer best known as the author of the classic high fantasy works , , and . Tolkien's works, namely The Lord of the Rings became a far-reaching cultural phenomenon. Prominent figures of the superhero and villain community are fans of Tolkien's works. For instance, when Karl Lykos became a humanoid Pterodon, he took the name "Sauron" after the villain of the books; the door of Billy Kaplin's room has a sign which reads "Speak, friend, and enter" is a reference from The Lord of The Rings; Spider-Man once referred to a group of heroes he joined forces with as the Fellowship of the Ring; the Runaways once went to a drive-in theater to watch the movie The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring based on Tokien's work. Captain America was also a fan of Tolkien.

john rost.name: John Rost
john rost.origin: thumb|left|200px John Rost gained the paranormal ability of superhuman durability in the White Event, and afterwards became a patient at the Clinic for Paranormal Research, where he was assigned to Therapy Group D and was commonly known as Scrap Iron. Scrap Iron was a friend and workout buddy of Bazooka until Bazooka joined the militant Black Powers and the two men became antagonists, even brawling in the hallways until Security broke them up. When the Clinic was raided by cops, Scrap Iron tried to make a break for it with two of the women patients Pamela Leighton and Sally Gallagher, but Sally was shot by a cop. Incensed, Scrap Iron attacked the cop, shrugging off his shotgun blasts, before grabbing his gun and apparently beating him to death with it. It is unknown if Scrap Iron survived the resulting battle between cops and patients in the Clinic, though given the nature of his paranormality, it's likely he did. If he did survive, it's likely he was drafted into the military like other male paranormals.
powers: Scrap Iron possessed the power of . It is unknown how durable he was, but he was able to survive being shot, even at close range.
abilities: Scrap Iron had some ability in hand-to-hand combat.

john russel.name: John Russel
john russel.origin: John Russel was an unemployed New Yorker who fell into paranoia and violence during the Serpent’s Fear Itself campaign. Afraid of eviction and convinced that others intended to harm him, John armed himself and barricaded his apartment as the city descended into panic. Consumed by fear and confusion, he eventually shot a man he mistakenly believed was invading his home. Later, wracked with guilt, John entered a crowded church while armed and emotionally unstable. Before the situation could escalate further, Spider-Man intervened and informed him that the victim had survived. Overcome with remorse, John broke down in front of the congregation and surrendered his weapon to the church’s priest, pleading for forgiveness. Following the end of the crisis, the unnatural fear affecting him finally lifted, allowing him to begin recovering psychologically from the traumatic events.

john saxton.name: John Saxton
john saxton.origin: Before his death, John Saxton had been engaged to marry a woman named Barbara, but suspected her of having an affair with his brother Donald. Yielding to his paranoia, John hired a private detective to spy on them, and he received a report which seemed to confirm his suspicions, as Donald was heard to tell Barbara that he loved her. Enraged, John undermined a rock formation so that an avalanche would eventually fall on Donald and Barbara's picnic grounds, but read the rest of the report and learned that his suspicions were misguided (Donald meant that he only loved Barbara as a SISTER). Panic stricken, John ran to the picnic area and shouted at Donald and Barbara to get back. Unfortunately, the noise of John's shouts caused the avalanche to occur, and he was killed by the falling rocks. Donald and Barbara survived, but would never know what had truly happened.

john scott.name: John Scott
john scott.origin: John Scott was framed for a murder he did not commit and found guilty and sentenced to death. John's son Larry attempted to get the true killer, notorious gambler Chips Brant, to confess, only to be knocked out and bound until after the execution. Breaking free and getting evidence that could clear his father's name, Larry arrived too late to prevent the execution and John Scott was executed for a crime he did not commit. John's death let Larry believe that justice needed to have time on it side, developing the costumed identity of Father Time. As Father Time, Larry's first order of business was to beat Chips and his men into submission, preventing them from fleeing town and leaving them for the authorities to be arrested, thus avenging his father's death.

john seton.name: John Seton
john seton.origin: In Mesquite Valley, Tex Taylor and Alkali Ike got involved in a murder mystery involving three outlaws and hidden loot. While investigating the circumstances they came to the aid of Beth Seton, whose father John was one of the original outlaws. John, remorseful of his involvement in the robbery, had re-mortgaged his ranch and paid back his share of the stolen money before being murdered. Tex and Alkali helped Beth recover the rest of the loot and gunned down the last surviving outlaw, now the sheriff, so that they could recover the money and save the ranch.

john shaffer.name: John Shaffer
john shaffer.origin: Karl Shaffer was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. In the fall of 1944 he began living with his uncle John a New England artist known for his silhouette paintings of monsters attacking people. When a deposit of Zorite was discovered in the area -- a rare metal that was beneficial for the production of arms -- Karl and his Nazi allies began plotting to prevent the American authorities from discovering it. To this end, Karl used trickery to make it appear as though the Shadow Monster in his uncles paintings had come to life and began murdering people in order to keep people away from the quarry where the Zorite was discovered. At first he only used a flashlight to project an image of a fake attack, leaving no trace of a victim or evidence of murder, stumping eye witnesses and local authorities. However, they were forced to actually kill someone when a baseball player ventured into the quarry after his game ball was hit into it. By this time Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes were on the scene having heard the murder and began questioning people about it. In order to try and further convince people that they were being stalked by a monster, Karl told Steve and James about his uncles paintings, then told them that his uncle was out of town. When Steve and James paid a visit to the Shaffer castle as Captain America and Bucky, Karl and his men prepared to convince the two heroes of the monsters existence or eliminate them. However, in attempting to eliminate them, Cap and Bucky knocked out one of Shaffer's minions revealing the Nazi connection to the plot. Karl then attempted to kill them by activating a trap floor causing them to fall into a pool of water in a tunnel below the estate. He then knocked out his uncle and dressed him in a costume in the hopes that he would be accused of the murder and attempted to flee. Cap and Bucky freed themselves and raced after Karl as he attempted to get away in a passenger truck. Struggling with Cap while trying to keep on the road, Karl is unmasked. Unwilling to face capture, Karl then drove the truck off the edge of a cliff while Cap and Bucky bailed out. The resulting explosion killed Karl, ending his plans.

john smithers.name: John Smithers
john smithers.origin: John Smithers was the owner of the Star Newspaper of the town of Midvale. Unknown to all, he was also the leader of the local rackets, using his position of power as a cover for his criminal activities. When he hired a man named Brown to be the editor of his paper, Brown began to write a number of anti-racket articles for the paper. Unable to fire Brown due to his clean work ethic, Smithers sent some of his men to eliminate him. This attack was stopped by the Eternal Makkari who was then posing as a normal human named Harry Cane and moonlighting as costumed hero Hurricane. Impressed by Harry's fighting ability, Brown hired him as a reporter for his paper. Hurricane then used the press to make himself a target of the racket men, easily defeating them with his powers and learning that their leader was really John Smithers. Confronting Smithers, the two fought over the printing press. No match for Hurricane, Smithers was easily disarmed and attempted to rush at the hero. Moving out of the way, Hurricane left Smithers to trip over the railings into the printing press below and a painful death.
weapons: Smithers was armed with a pistol.

john steele american soldier.name: John Steele (American Soldier)
john steele american soldier.origin: ===American Civil War=== John Steele was an American soldier who fought for the Union during the American Civil War. At some point during the war, he was sent by the Union to spy on the Confederacy. In 1865, by the end of the war, Steele was discovered to be a Union spy by a group of Confederate soldiers led by Aloysius Thorndrake. While escaping from them, he stumbled into a portal that connected Earth to Mars. The portal was a pathway through a sidereality that would become known as the Vanishing Point, where an ancient entity known as the Abyss was trapped since the dawn of time. Steele and the Confederate soldiers who were chasing him were tainted by said entity's touch and became his servants. At an unspecified point after that, however, Steele got free of the Abyss' control. thumb|left|John Steele during World War I ===World War I=== John Steele was a member of the U.S. Army that saw combat in Europe during World War I. In his only recorded mission during that time, he helped to liberate a spy named Marie Antoinette from behind enemy lines. At some time during the end of World War I, John Steele was somehow captured by the German army and placed in stasis so he could be studied later. ===World War II=== John Steele also fought during World War II. By February of 1940, John Steele's body was moved to a lab located in Frankfurt, Germany. There, Nazi scientists, including Abraham Erskine, sought to unlock the secrets of Steele's abilities for Project: Nietzsche. Their attempts were met with little success. Following Erskine's defection to the United States, his successors continued to try and learn Steele's secrets until the summer of 1940. A secret mission carried out by the Sky-Devils, Nick Fury, and Red Hargrove would see the facility in Frankfurt bombed, freeing Steele from his captivity. Active again for the first time in twenty years, Steele quickly caught up with the rest of the world and began killing Nazis. He would liberate a small German town before tracking down the Sky-Devils, Fury, and Hargrove and joining them in their mission to bomb Nazi forces. However, in the early days of 1941, Steele and the others would come back to the town that he had liberated earlier to find that everyone had been slaughtered by the Red Skull. Although his allies were being pulled back to their respective countries, John vowed to avenge these people and kill the Red Skull. In the summer of '41, John Steele had tracked the Red Skull to a lab where Nazi scientists were busy attempting to duplicate Erskine's super-soldier formula. He witnessed as the Skull outed Professor Eric Schmitt as a Jew and had him taken away to a concentration camp. One individual that Steele took specific notice of was the Atlantean rebel Meranno (a.k.a. the U-Man), who just recently allied himself with the Nazis. By the fall of that year, Steele tracked the Red Skull to a Nazi fortress where he had a meeting with the Imperial Japanese forces. Snooping through their files, Steele learned that the Nazi-Atlantean-Japanese Axis was plotting two attacks on American soil: one on Pearl Harbor in Hawaii, and the other on Washington, D.C. Steele fought his way to a Free French outpost and relayed the information to Nick Fury, warning him that the attack would happen on December 7th 1941. Steele's information would make American forces prepare for the attack on Pearl Harbor and Washington D.C. While Captain America (Steve Rogers), Bucky, and Namor succeeded in halting the attack on Washington, the Human Torch and Toro could only lessen the devastation at Pearl Harbor. The two battles led to the United States finally entering World War II. John Steele continued to operate behind enemy lines slaying Nazi forces. Shortly after the invasion of Normandy, Aloysius Thorndrake lured John Steele into a trap and converted him into a member of his Shadow Council. ===Modern Age=== thumb|right|As a member of the Shadow Council Decades later, Steele helped a Life Model Decoy of Nick Fury who had all of the spy's memories (courtesy of the Zodiac Key Scorpio used to reprogram him) escape from S.H.I.E.L.D. Naming him Max, Steele convinced the LMD to join the Shadow Council and he eventually became the organization's head of security. When the Shadow Council came into conflict with the Secret Avengers, Steele developed a heated rivalry with their leader and his former ally, Steve Rogers. After capturing Steele, Rogers was able to reconnect with him through the Shadow Council's influence, and he became an ally. However, he was later killed on an undercover mission in Bagalia by the new Masters of Evil assembled by Max Fury.

In the summer of '41, John Steele had tracked the Red Skull to a lab where Nazi scientists were busy attempting to duplicate Erskine's super-soldier formula. He witnessed as the Skull outed Professor Eric Schmitt as a Jew and had him taken away to a concentration camp. One individual that Steele took specific notice of was the Atlantean rebel Meranno (a.k.a. the U-Man), who just recently allied himself with the Nazis. By the fall of that year, Steele tracked the Red Skull to a Nazi fortress where he had a meeting with the Imperial Japanese forces. Snooping through their files, Steele learned that the Nazi-Atlantean-Japanese Axis was plotting two attacks on American soil: one on Pearl Harbor in Hawaii, and the other on Washington, D.C. Steele fought his way to a Free French outpost and relayed the information to Nick Fury, warning him that the attack would happen on December 7th 1941. Steele's information would make American forces prepare for the attack on Pearl Harbor and Washington D.C. While Captain America (Steve Rogers), Bucky, and Namor succeeded in halting the attack on Washington, the Human Torch and Toro could only lessen the devastation at Pearl Harbor. The two battles led to the United States finally entering World War II. John Steele continued to operate behind enemy lines slaying Nazi forces. Shortly after the invasion of Normandy, Aloysius Thorndrake lured John Steele into a trap and converted him into a member of his Shadow Council. ===Modern Age=== thumb|right|As a member of the Shadow Council Decades later, Steele helped a Life Model Decoy of Nick Fury who had all of the spy's memories (courtesy of the Zodiac Key Scorpio used to reprogram him) escape from S.H.I.E.L.D. Naming him Max, Steele convinced the LMD to join the Shadow Council and he eventually became the organization's head of security. When the Shadow Council came into conflict with the Secret Avengers, Steele developed a heated rivalry with their leader and his former ally, Steve Rogers. After capturing Steele, Rogers was able to reconnect with him through the Shadow Council's influence, and he became an ally. However, he was later killed on an undercover mission in Bagalia by the new Masters of Evil assembled by Max Fury.
fields.notes: John Steele being a superstrong and durable soldier fighting in a war makes him Timely Comics' answer to Hugo Danner. It is possible that John Steele got his powers from being experimented on by aliens, given the image that kept recurring in the experimental memory recall system the Secret Avengers used to break the control the Shadow Council had on his mind.

john stennis.name: John Stennis
john stennis.origin: Doctor John Stennis began practicing medicine in Clairton, West Virginia, 35 years before Rom arrived. Slightly less than 15 years before Rom's arrival, Doctor Stennis helped deliver James "Jimmy" Marks, the only child of farmer Jacob Marks and his wife Marjorie, at the Marks' farmhouse in the hills beyond Clairton. Years later, on Jimmy's fifteenth birthday, Doctor Stennis was called by Jacob Marks to assist his wife but when he arrived at the farm he found that all of the livestock was dead and that Marjorie was barely alive after something had caused her to age over fifty years. After a remorseful Jacob inadvertently revealed that he was a Dire Wraith, he told the doctor that the horror responsible for what had happened to Marjorie was their son. When Jimmy then allowed Stennis to see him in his hideous true form, the doctor fled in terror. After reaching the town, Doctor Stennis revealed that Jimmy Marks was "some kind of monster." Later, Doc Stennis was called to the Jones' household by Lorraine Jones because her three children were all sick. While there he fell victim to the same Wraith fog that had secretly taken control of the children.

john trent explorer.name: John Trent (Explorer)
john trent explorer.origin: John Trent was an explorer and collector of rare and strange artifacts. In the summer of 1942, he sought out the headless idol of India, for its rare and valuable emerald stone. Because the object was considered sacred and also supposedly cursed, with legends saying those who sought the emerald were later found decapitated. Trent put an expensive insurance on the emerald, secretly hoping that it would be stolen so that he could cash in on the policy. Despite the warnings of his Indian guide Sidot, Trent obtained what he thought was the real idol. However, Sidot -- hoping to keep the treasure safe -- produced a fake, with the original remaining in India. Sidot, with the aid of some of his colleagues, attempted to slay Trent and steal the phony gem in order to make people believe in the curse. Their attempt to behead Trent was stopped by Father Time who was going to visit Trent in his civilian identity of Larry Scott. After saving Trent's life a number of times from his attackers, Trent demanded that Father Time give up the emerald, blurting out the truth about the insurance policy. When Father Time refused to listen, Trent pulled a gun out on the hero and the would-be jewel thieves. Father Time disarmed Trent and learned about the double cross from Sidot. Trent, Sidot and his men were all turned over to the authorities. Trent's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: Trent armed himself with a pistol.

john warden.name: John Warden
john warden.first_appearance: Nick Fury, Agent of SHIELD Vol 1 6
john warden.origin: John Warden was a Psi-agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., assigned to a set of nine shadow facilities in the United States. He was contacted by Nick Fury from the Andes Mountains where a hidden colony of aliens were found to be using their cumulative psychic power to draw an asteroid towards Earth on a collision course, but was stymied to find that the whole of the Psi-division, even channeling their energies through their telepathic amplifier system, wasn't enough to penetrate the aliens' efforts. Years later, when S.H.I.E.L.D. was infiltrated during the Secret Invasion and subsequently disassembled, Warden's job was to mindwipe the agents at the shadow facilities and then proceed to Red Worm, the psi-agent proceeding and quarantine facility, to be placed in bio-stasis, in which he remained, considered as an active agent, as S.H.I.E.L.D. was dismantled and replaced by H.A.M.M.E.R.. He did this job admirably. Red Worm was subsequently raided by Hydra. Three psi-agents were revived too fast, and at least two of them were consequently executed, while the rest were kidnapped by Hydra and repurposed for their own needs. Warden's fate remains unknown.
powers: Psychic powers
affiliations: Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-616)/Members

john white.origin: In 1587, John White lead an expedition to the Americas. He became governor at the permanent settlement on Roanoke Island. This was the earliest effort to establish a permanent English colony. White returned to England for supplies. In 1591, a young girl arrived at the colony of Roanoke. She was revealed to be a vampire and turned all the 121 settlers into vampires leaving only one message carved into a tree: "Croatoan". The return expedition was delayed due to various reasons. Governor White finally returned to Roanoke Island, but found the colony had been long deserted finding the message "Croatoan". The colonists at Jamestown tried to find the colonists but to no avail.

john wilding.name: John Wilding
john wilding.origin: Greg Knight is out on a safari to hunt rhinos with the wealthy John Wilding. Wilding does not see the point of needing an entire safari to capture the dumb beasts, but Greg tries to convince him that the creatures are dangerous. However Wilding is not sold on the idea, pointing out that the natives will flee at the first sign of trouble. When they come across a herd of rhinos, Knight orders Wilding to shoot them when they catch their scent and begin charging. John freezes up, forzing Greg to take the lead. He shoots one of the creatures dead but his gun jams up leaving them defenceless against the rest of the herd. John realizes that the natives have disappeared. As Greg orders him up a tree he takes John's gun and begins firing at the rhinos but soon runs out of ammo. However before they can get close the natives drop a net down on the charging rhinos. One manages to slip away however and rams into the tree that John is hiding up in. Greg shoots the rhino that got away and John is saved from a nasty fall when he is caught in a net by the natives. In the aftermath of the incident, John realizes how wrong he was and thanks Greg for his help.

johnnie pinkham.name: Johnnie Pinkham
johnnie pinkham.origin: thumb|left|94px|Johnnie Pinkham Johnnie Pinkham was a man who was driven by revenge. As a boy he was locked up in a mausoleum overnight by a notorious prankster named Bryce and his friends Belton and Swanton. The event scarred Pinkham for life and vowed to get revenge. Many years later as adult, Pinkham learned that Bryce went on to devote his love of practical jokes to making an attraction called the House of Pranks where he himself would entertain guests as the Jester. Before the first opening of the House of Pranks, Pinkham attacks Bryce and locked him up in a dungeon below while he went on posing as the Bryce in the Jester costume and set out to murder Swanton and the other guests. Among the people in attendance were General Haywood, Private Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes. Taking the guests to a mock "Arsenic Bar", Pinkham gave Belton a glass of actual Arsenic. Thinking it a prank, Belton drank the lethal cocktail and died on the spot, everyone thinking it to be part of the joke. Realizing that the Jester had really killed Belton, Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes slipped away to change into Captain America and Bucky. Meanwhile, Pinkham had convinced Swanton to be attached to a torture wheel. Once more thinking it to be a prank Swanton agreed and was soon tortured to death. The other guests soon realized that the Jester was really killing people just as Captain America and Bucky arrived on the scene. They were too late to stop the Jester from killing Swanton, and the murderer then managed to escape. Chasing after Pinkham, Cap and Buck fell through a trap door into the dungeon below. There they found Bryce in the cell who told them that it was someone else posing as him. With Bryce's help, Captain America and Bucky used a secret passage to get to the Jester and stopped him before he could kill General Haywood. Unmasking the Jester, they learned who he was and what prompted his murder spree. Before Captain America could take him away, Pinkham once more attempted to escape through a nearby elevator. With no car in the elevator, Pinkham fell through the shaft to his apparent death.
weapons: The Jester used attack dogs and a supply of arsenic as well as a series of torture devices such as heating coils, trap doors, and torture wheels.

They were too late to stop the Jester from killing Swanton, and the murderer then managed to escape. Chasing after Pinkham, Cap and Buck fell through a trap door into the dungeon below. There they found Bryce in the cell who told them that it was someone else posing as him. With Bryce's help, Captain America and Bucky used a secret passage to get to the Jester and stopped him before he could kill General Haywood. Unmasking the Jester, they learned who he was and what prompted his murder spree. Before Captain America could take him away, Pinkham once more attempted to escape through a nearby elevator. With no car in the elevator, Pinkham fell through the shaft to his apparent death.
weapons: The Jester used attack dogs and a supply of arsenic as well as a series of torture devices such as heating coils, trap doors, and torture wheels.
fields.notes: The entry on states that this Jester could possibly be the same character as the Jester from . However, examination of the two characters shows that they are vastly different in appearance and motivations. Pinkham is depicted as an older man bent on revenge over a childhood of being bullied and the butt of practical jokes, while that Jester is depicted as a younger man who wishes to be recognized for his jokes.

johnny dee.name: Johnny Dee
johnny dee.species: Mutant with a conjoined parasitic mutant twin in his chest.
johnny dee.origin: ===Origin=== Johnny Dee was a mutant who had a sentient maw protruding from his chest. The maw could produce voodoo dolls after Johnny introduced a DNA sample of someone (like a strand of hair) into the creature's mouth. The creature would spit out a shell that contained a tiny, naked replica of the person; which allowed him control the person entirely. Johnny and the creature were not the same being. Johnny had taken to calling it "the freak." Johnny didn't consider himself a mutant, since the creature had a brain of its own. Two possibilities existed: Either the creature was merely a part of Johnny's body and he was in denial of his own mutant nature, or the creature was some sort of parasitic twin who possessed mutant capabilities, while Johnny did not. ===Decimation=== Johnny was one of the few mutants who kept his powers after the Scarlet Witch altered the world so that most of the world's mutants would lose all their powers. Living in Mutant Town, Johnny was about to be killed by mutant-hating thugs. After being rescued by Spider-Man, Johnny agreed to move over to the Xavier Institute for his own safety. There, he became part of The 198. When Magma arrived at the school, they shared a conversation about her recent outburst. Magma saw them as friends, but Johnny began falling in love with her. Magma admitted that Johnny looked cute but was a bit disgusted by his powers. Later, Johnny appeared to use his powers to create small duplicates of the mutant Magma, and later of Jazz as well. They appeared to be voodoo dolls that made placed targets under Johnny Dee's total control. Jazz spied on Johnny and found him making the voodoo doll of himself. Johnny later used the doll against Jazz and killed him. When the mysterious Mr. M sought out to gain the other 198 their freedom back, Johnny Dee (at the request of O*N*E leader Demetrius Lazer) had Leech depower Mr. M, and had Magma kill him. He then stated that he wouldn't ask anything in return for the job. "At least, not yet..." and decided to remain at Xavier's for his own, sinister reasons. ===Civil War=== Johnny continued to be a pawn in General Lazer's agenda, until Lazer was found out by Val Cooper and General Reyes. Both were incarcerated, but while Lazer was being interrogated by Cooper, he realized too late that Johnny did indeed touch him, at which point, Johnny snapped the neck of the voodoo doll of Lazer, killing him. Dee was placed behind bars. ===Krakoa=== At some point, Johnny Dee joined the mutant nation of Krakoa. When Fang had to fight Brimstone Love, he brought Dee with him. At a later point in time, he was apparently imprisoned in the Graymalkin Prison. He was subsequently freed thanks to the X-Men.

johnny do.name: Johnny Do
johnny do.origin: Johnny Do (not his real name) was a young paranormal boy being held at the Russian facility called the Siberian Project, although his place of origin is unknown (Johnny does not speak, so even his native language is unknown). His captors considered him dangerous and uncontrollable due to his pyrokinetic abilities coupled with his autism, and planned to lobotomize him until prevented from doing so by another of their inmates, Psi-Force member Thomas Boyd, who took control of their facility and forced them to make a deal: he would work to socialize 'Johnny' (the name Boyd gave the child) and make him into the assett the Russians wanted him to be, but if he failed, the Russians could terminate him and turn 'Johnny' loose on their enemies. Shortly afterward however, Psi-Force escaped the Project, taking Johnny Do with them. He remained with them when they became freelance operatives for the covert organization known as the Medusa Web. He appeared to be gradually beginning to interact with the world around him thanks to Boyd's patient care, but remained totally nonverbal and clearly never quite understood what was going on around him, though he was fiercely protective of Boyd and could at times be quite playful. According to an interview given by Psi-Force member Wayne Tucker some ten years later, Johnny was later injured in unrevealed circumstances, but was still alive. This report remains unconfirmed.
powers: Johnny is a paranormal with the power to ignite oxygen around him that then will burst into flames. : He also learned to glide by creating a type of updraft.

johnny jerome.name: Johnny Jerome
johnny jerome.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 4
johnny jerome.origin: Johnny Jerome was a thief that attempted to woo May Reilly with his wealth. The young May, who had been struggling during the Great Depression and nagged by her parents to only do things "that put food on your table", had at first been taken with the handsome man who could provide her with a good life where she and her children would never go to bed hungry. May almost married Johnny if it weren't for the intervention of Ben Parker, who revealed Jerome's criminal career. Shortly afterwards, the police closed in, and the other gangsters with Johnny fled. It was revealed that an expensive locket that Johnny attempted to woo May with had been stolen along with other money and jewels hours earlier, with Johnny having killed the jeweler in the robbery. Johnny was convicted of murder and robbery, and was sentenced to a long prison term. Ben successfully proposed marriage to May. Decades passed and Johnny aged. During this time, May's marriage to Ben ended with his death. Some time later, Johnny Jerome's health failed and he had had his sentence commuted on compassionate grounds. He learned May was still alive. Since she was widowed, Johnny figured he was free and clear to resume his relationship with her. This caused Spider-Man to stalk Johnny, figuring he had bad things in mind for May. However, May would nothing do with Johnny's attempts to rekindle the relationship. Finally giving up, Johnny admitted it was all over for him and breaks down. May said Johnny should do something to atone for his earlier misdeeds and that she would help Johnny find a place of his own to live the end of his days in. Spider-Man observed Johnny and May crying in each other's arms, then came to realize that Johnny was no longer a dangerous felon, but now a weak old man who was no danger to anyone, and that the right thing to do was allow Johnny to live the end of his life as a free man.

johnny morton.name: Johnny Morton
johnny morton.first_appearance: Strange Tales of the Unusual Vol 1 1
johnny morton.origin: Tom Morton embarked as a young man and traveled for 10 years, visiting many places in the world. Returning home, he was hosted by his brother Jack and his family, composed by his wife Ellen and their five years old son, Johnny, on the condition that he would tell them about his travels and adventures. When they asked him which place had impressed him the most, he replied that it was India where he met people capable of doing things bordering on magic. At the end of the story, his brother Jack told him that they too had a little magician at home, that is, little Johnny who, just by thinking of him, was able to make his toy train follow him wherever he went. Tom's disbelief almost led to annoyance, and even after verifying the veracity of Johnny's abilities he convinced the little boy that it was not possible that he could make an inanimate object obey him, and with tears in his eyes Johnny kicked the toy train who no longer obeyed him. At that point Tom decided that he had to return to India.
powers: Johnny was able to move inanimate objects, it is unclear whether this was due to congenital powers (mutant type or unusual mutation) or an unconscious ability to manipulate magical energies.

johnny revere.name: Johnny Revere
johnny revere.origin: thumb|left|95px|Johnny Revere Johnny Revere was a "screw ball" socialite during the 1940's. He was an unemployed inventor and swordsman who squandered his family estate. He was set to marry Gloria Delmare, who had a wealthy aunt. A thrill seeker he often committed thefts and had never been caught. By 1948, Johnny's estate was bankrupt. Unwilling to give up his opulent life style and get legitimate work, Johnny instead decided to return to thievery, this time a necessity he required. Having been called the "Gay Blade" by his society chums, he developed a costumed identity and adopted the moniker as his nom de plume, using swords and his various inventions to assist in his crimes. As the local winter carnival was beginning, the Gay Blade targeted Gloria's aunt and broke into her mansion in order to rob her safe. While he succeeded in disarming the outdoor alarm, he failed to disarm the one wired into the safe. He had the bad luck of robbing the mansion on the night that Gloria's aunt had the Human Torch and Toro as guests in her home. The pair were easily able to disarm the Gay Blade with their flame powers, but were forced to flame off or risk lighting the mansion on fire. The Gay Blade then managed to escape when Mrs. Delmare entered the room with a gun, initially accusing the two heroes for robbing her but she soon learned the truth. The Gay Blade fled the scene in a one-man helicopter of his own design. He landed it near his property when spotting Gloria coming by for a visit. Doffing his costume, Johnny convinced her that he was out on a walk. When she informed him that he aunt had been robbed, he agreed to accompany her back to the Delmare mansion. There he witnessed as the Torch marveled over the Gay Blade's use of swords and knives to break into the mansion. Johnny made the mistake of gloating about his swordsmanship and quickly recanted them in order to try and avoid suspicion. However, the damage was done and the Torch began investigating him and tapped Revere as the most likely suspect. Revere soon became aware that the Torch and Toro were then watching him and decided to eliminate them. fields.history: thumb|left|95px|Johnny Revere Johnny Revere was a "screw ball" socialite during the 1940's. He was an unemployed inventor and swordsman who squandered his family estate. He was set to marry Gloria Delmare, who had a wealthy aunt. A thrill seeker he often committed thefts and had never been caught. By 1948, Johnny's estate was bankrupt. Unwilling to give up his opulent life style and get legitimate work, Johnny instead decided to return to thievery, this time a necessity he required. Having been called the "Gay Blade" by his society chums, he developed a costumed identity and adopted the moniker as his nom de plume, using swords and his various inventions to assist in his crimes. As the local winter carnival was beginning, the Gay Blade targeted Gloria's aunt and broke into her mansion in order to rob her safe. While he succeeded in disarming the outdoor alarm, he failed to disarm the one wired into the safe. He had the bad luck of robbing the mansion on the night that Gloria's aunt had the Human Torch and Toro as guests in her home. The pair were easily able to disarm the Gay Blade with their flame powers, but were forced to flame off or risk lighting the mansion on fire. The Gay Blade then managed to escape when Mrs. Delmare entered the room with a gun, initially accusing the two heroes for robbing her but she soon learned the truth. The Gay Blade fled the scene in a one-man helicopter of his own design. He landed it near his property when spotting Gloria coming by for a visit. Doffing his costume, Johnny convinced her that he was out on a walk. When she informed him that he aunt had been robbed, he agreed to accompany her back to the Delmare mansion. There he witnessed as the Torch marveled over the Gay Blade's use of swords and knives to break into the mansion. Johnny made the mistake of gloating about his swordsmanship and quickly recanted them in order to try and avoid suspicion. However, the damage was done and the Torch began investigating him and tapped Revere as the most likely suspect. Revere soon became aware that the Torch and Toro were then watching him and decided to eliminate them. He broke into their room and replaced the Torch's razor blades with ones coated with a deadly poison, but the Torch was able to notice this switch before shaving his face the following morning. The Gay Blade met his defeat when he fell for one of the Torch's traps: His own girlfriend Gloria -- who was Queen of the Winter Fair -- was to wear a crown worth fifteen thousand dollars. Using specially made skates to skate on telephone poles, the Gay Blade attempted to steal the crown but fell to his death. The story closes with a view of Johnny Revere's grave, where he rests beneath blades of grass.
abilities: Johnny Revere was a master swordsman and sword swallower.
equipment: At one point the Gay Blade used specially made skates that allowed him to "skate" on telephone wires.
transportation: The Gay Blade briefly used a one man helicopter of his own design.

fields.notes: It should be noted that the usage of "Gay" here is by it's original definition, which is to be happy, as opposed to the more modern usage of the term which is in reference to someone who is homosexual. As such, the character "Gay Blade" is akin to calling him "Happy Blade".

johnny roarke.name: Johnny Roarke
johnny roarke.origin: Johnny Roarke was a longtime citizen of Springdale, Connecticut, as well as a notorious criminal who was eventually and imprisoned thanks to assistant D.A. Justin Baldwin. Returning after years in prison, he and his henchman Jenks came into town by plane, attempting to ambush Baldwin. Roarke had the luck to catch not only Baldwin, but his wife Maddie as well. Taking them out into the woods behind the Baldwins' house, Roarke attempted to execute them, but was foiled by the intervention of the town's local would-be super-hero, Speedball. Actually, the young "masked marvel" was the Baldwins' son Robbie, who had accidentally gained uncontrollable kinetic energy powers from his part-time job at a research lab; trying to get his power to settle down near his home, he had seen Roarke and Jenks holding his parents at gunpoint from a hilltop, and activated his powers while trying to tackle them. His powers had caused the appearance of his costume and altering the sound of his voice, and so, Robbie went unrecognized by his parents as he awkwardly fought the two criminals, who were thus captured and taken away by the police. Thus, Roarke’s revenge was foiled while Speedball unintentionally made his first public appearance.

johnny stanford.name: Johnny Stanford
johnny stanford.origin: Jenny and Johnny Stanford were the children of Edward Stanford and Ann Dodgson, whose sister Clare Dodgson was a detective. Their father was himself the district attorney of their hometown, but was also the masked crime lord Nemesis. When Clare's investigations began to endanger his secret life, Edward had his own family kidnapped in an attempt to scare Clare off the investigation while seeming innocent. Fortunately, the Dodgson sisters were possessed by the Uni-Power, and became twin Captains Universe who rescued the children. They also unmasked and exposed Ann's husband, leaving her with the task of raising their children alone. To spare them some of the pain, she only told Jenny and Johnny that their father had left them, keeping secret his double life as Nemesis.

johnston coffin.name: Johnston Coffin
johnston coffin.origin: The origins of the enigmatic being known as Johnston Coffin are unknown, but he is believed to be a powerful mutant. In 1968, he was contacted by the United States government to construct a maximum-security prison for disobedient teenagers, until it was closed due to unknown "circumstances" in 1973. He kept three children who were inmates in that prison, however, and over the years modified them into cyborgs, keeping them in perpetual agony while brainwashing them to serve only him. Several decades later, SHIELD attempted to arrest him for crimes against humanity, but he easily defeated and killed the entire team of arresting officers. It is also known that the CIA tried to kill him at some point, but the attempt failed and Coffin killed, stuffed, and mounted the attempted assassin in his office. Years later, at the height of the paranoia over teenage violence that followed the Columbine massacre, Coffin was once again charged by the government with opening a "House of Correction" for disobedient teenagers. His methods were brutal; any child who committed any form of disobedience could be abducted by Coffin's agents at any time and held indefinitely, and the penalty for attempting to escape was death. After a string of disappearances of teenagers were linked by Husk to the same point in the middle of the desert, Generation X decided to investigate Coffin's operation. Upon arriving at the House of Correction, Generation-X easily overpowered the rank-and-file guards, with Skin taking one captive to lead him to Coffin. Coffin ordered the guards to stand down, and turned loose the "Special Children," the cyborg teens from the '68 prison, now little more than living corpses wired up to massive machinery. Meanwhile, Skin confronted Coffin, who revealed his powers and effortlessly overpowered him, battering him with torrents of energy. Skin was only saved by the timely arrival of Banshee; as the other members of Generation-X below sadly euthanized the "Special Children," Banshee used his sonic scream to propel Coffin off the House of Correction's top floor, from which he plummeted to his death. Subsequently, all the children in his captivity were freed and reunited with their families.
weapons: It is known that Coffin has used a gun at least once in the past, but later seemed to eschew conventional weapons in favor of his superhuman abilities.

jolari.name: Jolari
jolari.origin: Jolari was the high chief of the Kwanyi who lived on the shores of the Lake of Death. For his own reasons, he agreed to help the Speakers of the Living Wind to gain knowledge about Conan and Valeria. When Jolari challenged Geyrus, he was helped by Ryku, who became the First Speaker himself. Jolari was then alerted of a staircase appearing from the ground, and sensed Dobanpu's presence. Jolari led the Kwanyi into battle against the Ichiribu, but he eventually died following the cataclysmic events after the summoning of the Living Wind.

jolen.name: Jolen
jolen.origin: Jolen is an Inhuman who gained his superhuman abilities by passing through the Terrigen Mist. He was selected alongside a number of other youth to be sent to earth on a sort of foreign exchange program. He adjusted quickly to the conditions of Earth, but had trouble understanding the nature of his peers, often overreacting to them. After hearing from one of his friends that Nahrees, a former love-interest, has been captured by Mister Chase, he quickly drove to Chicago, where she was being held prisoner. Jolen confronted Mister Chase, a hired hitman, and was shot in the head. After a bit of scuffle, Jolen revived, and used a root to murder the hitman. From here, Jolen took a darker moral path, threatening and killing several other people. In response to a report of Terrigen Crystals in New York City, Jolen was assembled with a team, and led an assault on the reported owner of the crystals. During the assault, the team was confronted by the Fantastic Four, and quickly defeated. The Fantastic Four turned the Inhuman team over to the Office of National Security (ONE), where they were detained. After being freed by Mala The Diviner and Dewoz, they retrieved the Terrigen crystals and captured the holder of the crystals, Dr. Cartwright. Having accomplished their mission, they returned to their Moon base.

jolene saulsby.name: Jolene Saulsby
jolene saulsby.first_appearance: Captain Marvel and the Carol Corps Vol 1 1
jolene saulsby.origin: 2nd LT Jolene Saulsby who went by the callsign Knock Knock was a pilot and member of the Banshee Squadron under the command of Captain Marvel. She participated in a flying drill to see which Banshee member could catch Danvers. After Captain Marvel maneuvered her way through the planes, Knock Knock was ordered by Blaze to make a hard right while she was coming in to get a target lock on Danvers. But the Captain gracefully dodged the plane's trajectory and won the exercise in the process. Soon enough the base's alarm went off as the nation of Hydra broke through their mutual border and tried to invade Hala Field. Jolene was was about to engage the enemy with the rest of the squadron but the incursion was stopped as the Thors intervened putting an end to Hydra's plans. Danvers ordered Jo and the others to abort and then rendezvous back at Hala Base. After some downtime at the barracks, The Squadron was sent off to their border on the ocean after they were ordered by Baroness Cochran to intercept a boat that was supposedly carrying an army of rogue Ultron robots. Jo was ordered to keep her weapons hot while she took a closer look at the ship. She told them to fire but when she saw a person on the boat, she told her Squadron to stop firing but it was too late as the missiles hit the ship blowing it up. Captain Marvel went M.I.A. after the explosion as the Baroness ordered Jolene and the others to return to base. Later on, Danvers showed up at the barracks with the only survivor from the ship. Jolene hung out at the barracks as Carol contacted Doctor Nayar in order to have her look at Captain Rhodes' injuries. After the doctor finished, the group had a discussion about the space above the sky known as the Void, which was where Carol had come from. Nayar called Bee a blasphemer and said she wasn't going to listen to any of the nonsense but Jolene stepped in the Doctor's way telling her that she was definitely going to hear what they had to say. Believing that they had been lied to the entire time, Carol instructed Jolene and Mack to make the appropriate upgrades to the planes to allow them to travel beyond Battleworld's sky. However, something went wrong when one member of the Banshee Squadron, Helen Cobb, went to test her aircraft on her own, and the aircraft exploded. Carol rushed Helen back to the barracks where Jolene assisted Bee in caring for Pancho's injuries. As they tried to patch her up, Carol decided that they needed to launch before anyone could catch up to what they were doing. Jo and the other Banshee's took off in their jets but they were being tracked by mission control after they passed by a stationary radar. The Baroness ordered for a second squadron to head out after them and blow them out of the sky. But Carol dealt with threat of the jets while Jo and the others headed to the rendezvous point. They met up with Carol and Rhodes at the discussed coordinates and went through their inventory to see what weapons they had available. As they began to plan for their next move, a loud boom in the sky was heard by Danvers who then took off to see what the noise was only to find a invading force of Thors heading in their direction. The Banshee's went to help Captain Marvel out while Rhodes and Pancho stayed on the island. After a bomb exploded on the shoreline which knocked the Corps off balance, they flew back in the air only to be intercepted by a barrage of weapons fire from Jo and the others. The Thor Kit Renner ended up turning against her fellow Corpsmen after Carol made her question her beliefs which allowed Jo and the Banshee's to fly into the void with Captain Marvel.

jolnir.origin: Jolnir is the son of a Light Elf mother and a Frost Giant father. The only being like himself, Jolnir was born with power unmatched by any being in the Nine Realms. Rather than use the power to conquer and rule, he instead sought to use it to help those too weak to help themselves, the children of the Nine Realms. Each winter solstice, Jolnir sets out and delivers gifts to the children of the Nine Realms... all in one night, a feat unmatched by anyone. On Midgard/Earth he is known as Santa Claus, the legendary gift-bringer and spirit of Christmas.

jomo kimane.name: Jomo Kimane
jomo kimane.origin: Nothing is known about Jomo's past, except that he was once Mutate 283 of the Genoshan slave-caste. He joined up with Crucible (Morlak) in his scheme to create a personal army of superhumans by placing the minds of his associates into the bodies of known superheroes. When Crucible captured the Fantastic Four, Jomo was placed in the Thing's body, while fellow henchmen Harry Soong and Farisa Mansour were placed in the bodies of the Human Torch and the Invisible Woman respectively. Crucible and his followers then staged a takeover of Genosha from the Magistrates, but the Four escaped and confronted the impostors; despite being in powerless bodies, they were able to use Reed Richards' technology to defeat their opponents and place their minds back in the proper bodies. Crucible's plan was cut short when he was killed by Wladyslav Shinski, who was himself killed in an act of self-sacrifice by Chief Magistrate Anderson.

when in possession of Ben Grimm's body, he utilized his powers.

jomo kimanye.name: Jomo Kimanye
jomo kimanye.origin: Jomo Kimayne's origin is unknown. He was first shown as a member of a race who had sought to avoid an ecological disaster by placing all their members into a never-ending VR hallucination, which would allow them to interact socially, keeping their minds and sanity keen. Within the scenario, which was an urban environment called "Shadow City", Jomo led a double life: by day a secretary for one of the wealthiest women in the city, by night its vigilante protector - Lockdown. Lockdown's life continued its eventful-if-cyclical pattern, until a group of interlopers - the Fantastic Four - landed on his planet. Caught by the robotic security, they were added to the program as a group of villainous "paraforms" known as the "Tetrad". However, they were then able to manage the impossible, and escape the simulation, before being spirited away by a malfunctioning teleporter. Lockdown, roused from the simulation with his accomplice, Rosetta Stone, as a protective safeguard, came to the conclusion that the Fantastic Four were a threat to the safety of the people of Shadow City, and vowed to stop them, by any means necessary. Later, he and Rosetta Stone arrived on Earth during a "contest of champions" being arranged by an alliance of aliens to trick the superheroes of Earth. The two heroes were instrumental in defeating the aliens and saving the heroes. Nothing has been seen of them since then; possibly they had a conversation with the Fantastic Four and went home.

jon ironfire moira iv 8.name: Jon Ironfire (Moira-IV.8)
jon ironfire moira iv 8.first_appearance: Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1
jon ironfire moira iv 8.origin: In the timeline designated Moira-IV.8, Orchis was successful in its mission to destroy mutantkind, leaving only a few scattered survivors. In time, Orchis was wholly usurped by the machines, who continued to wage war against the X-Men while using their advanced technology to summon a Dominion that could absorb them into its nigh omnipotent machine intellect. Knowing that the only hope of averting this lay in reseting their own timeline, the X-Men sought to find Mr. Sinister, knowing that his Moira Enigne would allow them to reset their timeline. Jon Ironfire was with a team of X-Men that embarked on a suicide mission at the Henry Gyrich Memorial Detention Center in order to secure access to the personality imprint of Feilong, a former Orchis associate who knew the location of Sinister. Despite Ironfire and every other member of the team dying, they were able to make telepathic contact with the rest of the X-Men to give them the information they had found.

jon ironfire moira vii 1.name: Jon Ironfire (Moira-VII.1)
jon ironfire moira vii 1.first_appearance: Storm & the Brotherhood of Mutants Vol 1 1
jon ironfire moira vii 1.origin: ===Year 10=== left|thumb|175px|Jon Ironfire in Year 10 After the destruction of Arakko, Jon Ironfire joined Storm's Brotherhood of Mutants and started living on Asteroid S. When Mystique came to the Asteroid disguised as Destiny, Ironfire detected her heat signature and stabbed her, making her abandon her disguise. Mystique then revealed that Sinister possessed a machine that resets reality via Clones of Moira MacTaggert, the group went to Muir Island to retrieve it, but Mystique betrayed them impersonating Wiz Kid, backstabbed Storm and took the engine with her. ===Year 100=== Still fighting alongside Storm and her Brotherhood, an older Jon Ironfire was instrumental in launching an assault on the World Farm, allowing them to steal the Moira Engine and hide it away, preventing the universe from being reset. During the attack, he was contacted by Mother Righteous, who asked him if he had any regrets. Ironfire responded he regretted taking a life during the Genesis War, but he feels better now, because he trusts Storm. Unfortunately for him, while creating a wormhole to flee away from Orbis Stellaris, Storm died, leaving the Brotherhood without a leader. ===Year 1000=== thumb|right Jon had by now spent almost 900 years guarding the World Farm, which had become an impregnable fortress, holding steady against every horror the universe had thrown at it. When Mr. Sinister crash landed on the Farm, Jon came out to meet him, having detected that he was being pursued by an Empire of the Red Diamond armada. Sinister asked Jon to trust him, telling him that together they could save the universe. Jon had Sinister, Old Oda, Craana the Commander, Bloodroot the Bone-Shaper, and Genas Mind-Flayer combine their powers to resurrect Storm in preparation for the battle to come. When Frost's chimeras attacked, they killed most of the Arakkii, leaving Jon one of the few survivors. As he cradled the dying Storm, Sinister took the opportunity to shoot him in the head. Jon had been prepared for his treachery however, and had coated his head with a sheath of metal blood. Before he could kill Sinister in retaliation, Sinister offered him an Iceman-gene cocktail, which was the only thing at hand that would allow Jon to challenge Professor X, whom Emma Frost's armada had summoned in the hopes of saving the timeline. As Jon fought Xavier, Sinister sacrificed every single Sinister-derived mutant in the galaxy, in the hopes of ascending into a Dominion. His plan failed, and Jon killed him for his murder of the entire galaxy, before allowing Moira MacTaggert to reset the timeline.

jon porter.name: Jon Porter
jon porter.origin: Jon Porter was a student at the Empire State University who attended the demonstration for Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.' Catalyst during a simposium on renewable resources. The demonstration was interrupted by the Lethal Legion, who trapped the five hundred spectactors and murdered several of them during their attempt to steal the Catalyst. The massacre was stopped by the Sin-Eater, who seemingly murdered all the villains. After the incident, Jon was interviewed by reporter Norah Winters for Threats and Menaces. He compared the Sin-Eater to the Punisher, but favored the former.

jon spectre.name: Jon Spectre
jon spectre.origin: In the late 37th-early 39th century, Jon Spectre was a member of the Clan Chosen. Roughly in the late 36th century, Apocalypse ascended to power and ruled much of North America unchallenged, for 100 years, where humans and whoever else resistant to his rule could be killed at any moment. The Clan Askani were the only rebellion left to opposed Apocalypse's rule. Years later, following the destruction of the Askani Sisterhood, by the New Canaanites led by Ch'vayre and Stryfe, and Apocalypse, by Nathan Dayspring, Jon joined the Clan Chosen, an Askani-inspired team of freedom fighters, formed originally by Nathan, Tetherblood, and Aliya. Training in the Askani ways under surviving Askani elders, the Clan Chosen repeatedly battled the New Canaanites and the Scions of Apocalypse, led by Stryfe. The Clan Chosen also clashed with the Neo-Canaanites, a group that also wished to claim Apocalypse's power. ===Traitor to the Clan=== After decades of battle, the Clan Chosen signed a long-lasting peace treaty with the New Canaanites, but Nathan, upset by rumors that Apocalypse had survived, convinced the Clan's Askani Council that they needed to fight again. However, ensuing battles cost the Clan dearly and the following war nearly destroyed all life on Earth. Among the dead was Jon’s father, Adam Spectre. After Jon was accused of being a traitor to the Clan Chosen, he traveled to the modern era to warn Cannonball of the danger of Dayspring. After convincing Cannonball of Dayspring's destructive behavior, Dayspring (known as Cable) arrived with X-Force and battled Spectre, until Cable, who was attempting to recruit Cannonball back into X-Force to fight against the Skornn, left with the remaining members of X-Force. Spectre, Cannonball, and Sunspot aided X-Force, Wolverine, Deadpool, Thing, Human Torch, and the Mutant Liberation Front in battling the Skornn. Jon remained in the modern era and was depowered during the Decimation, and the energies that he used to control were then drawn to The Collective.
powers: None, Jon Spectre is a depowered mutant. {{Navigation

jonah lamb.name: Jonah Lamb
jonah lamb.origin: Jonah Lamb and his father were travelling through China during the 1940s when tragedy struck them. While visiting Shanghai, a collapsing building claimed the life of the elder Lamb, leaving Jonah orphaned. With nowhere to go, the boy fled Shanghai and sought to travel around China on his own and find adventure. One night, he sought shelter in a nearby barn and found American adventurer Budd Powers inside. The two became fast friends and traveling partners. The following day, they came into a small Chinese village under siege by raiders. Attacking the raiders, both Budd and Jonah were captured and tied up in a house while the raiders continued their looting. The duo were freed by a Chinese boy named Sen Yat, and they help the visitors send the raiders fleeing. Thanked by the villagers, Budd and Jonah only accepted a meal and a roof over the heads for the night in return for their bravery. Their subsequent activities are unrecorded.

When Hydra took over the United States and Camp Echo-1 was repurposed into an Inhuman internment camp, the androids were reprogrammed and duplicated to guard with extreme prejudice. jonas hale.name: Jonas Hale
jonas hale.origin: Jonas Hale was an administrator for the Roxxon Oil corporation. He attempted to procure supplies of the valued mineral Vibranium from the nation of Wakanda, but when the Wakandans refused to sell their precious ore, Hale was forced to look elsewhere. His people discovered a small island in the South Atlantic Ocean that was rich in Vibranium, and not protected by any nations staking a claim. He put together a team to excavate the island and established a faux Naval regiment to guard the island and keep competitors from away from their operations. Hale's project was discovered by two known super-heroes, the Atlantean Prince Namor, and the Avenger known as Iron Man. Jonas Hale succeeded in capturing two of Iron Man's close allies, Jim Rhodes and Bethany Cabe. Iron Man and the Sub-Mariner exposed Roxxon's interests on the island, and Hale, determined to keep anyone else from discovering the Vibranium, detonated a supply of explosives that destroyed the island. Hale himself, however, managed to evade capture.

jonas keller.name: Jonas Keller
jonas keller.origin: Jonas Keller was a successful soldier in the United States Army, thanks to his precognitive powers, and he was eventually made the youngest Colonel in Army history and transferred to Special Forces, as a part of which he vanished in the Middle East. He resurfaced Stateside as leader of the white supremacist group W.A.R., which he started not because he was a racist, but simply to prove he could get people willing to die and kill for him under his power. When W.A.R. bombed the Los Angeles Airport, the Army brought in Cable to take Keller down. Keller, as it turned out, wanted to meet Cable, and set events in motion so that he could. He arranged for several of his own men to die in a suicide bombing on Cable, which he knew Cable could survive. Cable read the mind of a badly-injured survivor of the bombing to learn Keller's location and confronted him. Keller bragged about the success his powers had brought him to Cable, and Cable, in response, telepathically removed his powers. He then left Keller alone and Keller shot himself.

jonas ravencroft.name: Jonas Ravencroft
jonas ravencroft.origin: Doctor Jonas Ravencroft, a descendant of British settler Molly Ravencroft, purchased the land in Westchester County in 1899, determined to provide proper psychiatric care for the people of New York. Despite numerous setbacks, by the early 1900s he had established the Ravencroft Institute for the Criminally Insane. At some point, Doctor Ravencroft took to recording a journal detailing the history of Westchester County, his family, and the Ravencroft Institute. While a brilliant psychologist by the standards of his time, Doctor Ravencroft naively placed his trust in Doctor Nathaniel Essex - a sadistic mad scientist who proceeded to build a secret laboratory under the Ravencroft Institute, where he carried out numerous unethical experiments. After the disappearance of Doctor Claudia Russell, Doctor Ravencroft suspected Essex to be responsible and eventually ended his reign of terror over the institute. Despite his initial skepticism, Doctor Ravencroft eventually became a believer in the supernatural after personally encountering mystical beings such as Loki Laufeyson. In the 1930s, Weapon Plus commandeered Ravencroft Institute and began performing cruel experiments on the inmates with the aid of Count Dracula, with Doctor Ravencroft being - in his own words - too much of a coward to stop them. When Captain America and Bucky Barnes attacked the institute looking to rescue a friend who'd been abducted, Doctor Ravencroft unleashed the monstrous results of Weapon Plus' experiments before committing suicide.

jonathan bryant digitek.name: Jonathan Bryant (Digitek)
jonathan bryant digitek.origin: Not much of the early history of Jonathan Bryant is known before he started to work in Nakasoni Corporation's London branch. He worked on a project called Digitek. He had designed a state of the art computer using Protosilicon, a new component that was discovered quite recently. Protosilicon mimicked human brain tissue making the computer one living brain. They called it "Psi-Key." When they were running a test someone had contaminated the test program with a virus at the same time the room was invaded by a hostile force and Jonathan also got shot in the progress. He fell inside the dome containing the Psi-Key and it linked to his brain downloading some parts of itself inside of him. The task force stole the Psi-Key and setup a bomb to cover their tracks. After they left Jonathan got up mumbling something in binary and noticing the bomb, but couldn't do anything before it exploded destroying the building. Somehow Jonathan didn't die and found his wife's calling card in the rubble. He transferred himself through phone lines to his apartment trying to convince his wife that he was Jonathan. When he touched his wife he absorbed some electricity and noticed that it made him feel stronger. He then sucked power from every power source and Digitek was born. His wife didn't believe him so he decided to show her and when she saw what happened to his husband. She still didn't believe him. He then revealed that Nakasoni was just a front the project was really founded by organization named Mys-Tech. She still didn't believe him and tried to call the police, but Digitek escaped through the same phone she was using. The next day Digitek went back to the Nakasoni Corporation buildings ruins searching for some clues and met Samantha there too. They found a piece of the bomb and Digitek found out that Miracle Systems manufactured it. He then transported himself to Miracle Systems headquarters in London. When he arrived he was comforted by Bacillicons who had been affected by the virus turning them into the same kind of beings as he himself. They attacked him, but he again transported himself before they hit him. Purge ordered Byte and Kay to follow him. He used his wife's beeper to come back the real world and almost instantly got attacked by the two villains. As the fight ensued Digitek learned that he could turn his arms to any kind of weapon he could imagine. Digitek managed to win the fight and escaped before Purge arrived. Digitek and Samantha went to an old cottage in Cotswold Hills. When they arrived there Digitek decided to call for help and transported Deathlok there. After Digitek explained things to Deathlok and recharged himself Bacillicons attacked them. They managed to severely injure Byte, but were forced to retreat. Deathlok was transported back to the United States and Digitek left with Samantha to London. Digitek and Samantha decided to attack Miracle Systems. When Digitek arrived he ran into Kay and after a short fight destroyed her. Then Purge arrived and a fight ensued between him and Digitek. The fight went on for sometime and Digitek won by shooting Purge with his hand cannon, but Purge managed to upload his persona through the phone lines to Mr. Greville, who then attacked Samantha, but Digitek intervened. Purge graphed Digitek and threw him at the Psi-Key. It was a big mistake, because when Digitek impacted with the Psi-Key he cleaned the virus from it and destroyed both Purge and Byte. It looked like he himself finally died too, but at his funeral he rematerialized next to his tombstone. He revealed that he doesn't need a solid body anymore and is now just pure energy. They left the cemetery side by side. ===Civil War=== He resurfaced in America where he was arrested for violation of the Superhuman Registration Act and transferred to Prison 42 in the Negative Zone. He seemingly killed himself by digitizing his hand into a weapon but this was believe to have been an elaborate escape plan, since Digitek can only be harmed by extensive damage to his central processing unit which was not the case here.
abilities: Jonathan is a genius in the fields of computers and microelectronics.

jonathan caesar.name: Jonathan Caesar
jonathan caesar.origin: Jonathan Caesar was the owner and resident of the spacious Manhattan apartment building Bedford Towers, in which Peter Parker and his wife Mary Jane Watson came to live. However, this was no accident, as Caesar was obsessively in love with the famous model Mary Jane, and had arranged it so she would move in to the building he owned and lived in. Caesar kidnapped Mary Jane and imprisoned her in a reinforced room inside Bedford Towers itself. Caesar hired Styx and Stone to oppose anyone who tried to investigate, such as Spider-Man, who was secretly Mary Jane's husband Peter. Peter desperately searched for his wife across New York City, not realizing she was still within their apartment building. However, it was Mary Jane who would be responsible for her own rescue. Mary Jane knocked Caesar out with a lamp, stole his gun and made her escape. Caesar was sent to jail, but even while imprisoned, he used his business connections to have the couple evicted from his building, and had Mary Jane blacklisted from fashion companies, thus denying her modeling work. After getting out of jail, Caesar tried to kill Mary Jane, but was killed himself at the hands of Hal Goldman, another obsessive stalker who also wanted to possess Mary Jane.

jonathan chambers.name: Jonathan Chambers
jonathan chambers.origin: ===Early Life=== At thirteen, Jonathan was thrust into tragedy when his father, Tim Chambers, died in a fatal car crash. Determined to shed light on the enigmatic world of mutants, Jonathan wrote a book the illuminating tome, "Fatal Attractions: Mutants & Men," in later years. This literary endeavor propelled him into the limelight, as he embarked on a whirlwind tour of television talk shows. However, his journey took a startling turn during an appearance on The Geraldo Rivera Show, where he found himself on the receiving end of an unexpected attack. Undeterred, Chambers leveraged the proceeds from his book to acquire a secluded island enclave in Florida's Big Pine Key. Here, he enlisted the expertise of esteemed scientists Dr. Josef Kleinbaumm and Dr. Nancy Alter to conduct research in relative isolation. ===Reader's of his work=== On a journey to meet with Gabrielle Haller in New York City, Adrian Eiskalt found himself engrossed in Chambers' book. While on a airplane, Eiskalt's attention was abruptly drawn to a fellow passenger, whom he mistook for the infamous Magneto. Swiftly reaching for a poisoned needle-pen, but stopped when he realised his mistake. ===Empyrean=== Chambers was later confronted by the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants on his island. Disarming tensions, he clarified that their presence was welcome as friends, not foes, citing their shared history with Pyro, a former member of their ranks. However, harmony proved short-lived. When the Blob's behavior soured, Chambers issued a stark warning, met with defiance. Unleashing a potent energy blast, he inflicted upon the Blob a visceral empathy for the world's pain, revealing his unique power and his altruistic mission: to create a sanctuary for the suffering. Soon after, the X-Men trio of Cyclops, Rogue, and the Beast arrived, prompting further scrutiny. Doubt shadowed their interaction, especially regarding Chambers' connections to the Brotherhood. As tensions escalated and a clash between the X-Men and the Brotherhood loomed, Chambers intervened with a display of his extraordinary powers, quelling the conflict by inducing a shared sense of agony. Revealing himself as the Mutant Empyrean, he admitted to his hidden agenda, acknowledging his exploitation of mutant suffering for profit. This sparked a heated debate over the ethics of his actions, with Empyrean defending his belief in offering solace amidst pain. The situation intensified with the arrival of government agents led by Henry Gyrich, accusing Empyrean of coercion. In the aftermath, Empyrean reaffirmed his island's status as a sanctuary for mutants, extending an invitation to Revanche, who chose a different path. As the X-Men departed, Empyrean faced a sobering realization to align his actions with his professed ideals. Their parting words served as a poignant reminder for him to uphold the principles advocated in his writings. ===Time Gliders=== As tensions escalated as the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants plotted within Chambers' residence. Their surveillance unearthed the Beast's creation: a Time Glider with purported capabilities to combat the dreaded Legacy Virus. However, Empyrean harbored darker intentions, seeking to manipulate time to propagate the virus and expand the death toll. He tricked the Brotherhood and orchestrated the theft of the Time Glider to further his nefarious scheme. In a nocturnal raid on Xavier Mansion, Commando breached the school, engaging in a brief fight with Cyclops before stealing with the Time Glider. 300px|right|thumb The X-Men, hot on the trail of Commando, converged upon Chambers' island, dividing their efforts. Amidst clashes with the Brotherhood, Wolverine found himself locked in combat with the Blob, while Chambers and Commando tried to activate the Time Glider. The Beast toiled tirelessly on a replacement device to counter the stolen one. The Beast's tireless efforts bore fruit as he completed the second Time Glider. Meanwhile, Empyrean and Commando successfully harnessed the stolen device's power, poised to execute their plan. As chaos erupted as the X-Men clashed with the Brotherhood. Amidst the chaos, the Beast intervened, confronting Commando and Empyrean to thwart their scheme. Yet, as victory seemed within reach, Chambers activated the Time Glider, vanishing into the tides of time. Transported to the prehistoric era, Empyrean faced imminent peril, cornered by a fearsome Tyrannosaurus. As the dust settled, the Beast enacted a daring retrieval plan, summoning the Time Glider back to the present, leaving Chambers stranded amidst the primeval wilderness, on the brink of a perilous encounter with prehistoric creature. ===Black Womb=== It was disclosed that he returned to the present but became insignificant after the cure for the Legacy Virus. Cable and Nate uncovered the whereabouts of a Parvenu Industries laboratory belonging to the mutant Jonathan Chambers. They swiftly located Chambers, barely clinging to life and being exploited as a power source

Meanwhile, Empyrean and Commando successfully harnessed the stolen device's power, poised to execute their plan. As chaos erupted as the X-Men clashed with the Brotherhood. Amidst the chaos, the Beast intervened, confronting Commando and Empyrean to thwart their scheme. Yet, as victory seemed within reach, Chambers activated the Time Glider, vanishing into the tides of time. Transported to the prehistoric era, Empyrean faced imminent peril, cornered by a fearsome Tyrannosaurus. As the dust settled, the Beast enacted a daring retrieval plan, summoning the Time Glider back to the present, leaving Chambers stranded amidst the primeval wilderness, on the brink of a perilous encounter with prehistoric creature. ===Black Womb=== It was disclosed that he returned to the present but became insignificant after the cure for the Legacy Virus. Cable and Nate uncovered the whereabouts of a Parvenu Industries laboratory belonging to the mutant Jonathan Chambers. They swiftly located Chambers, barely clinging to life and being exploited as a power source

jonathan cole.name: Jonathan Cole
jonathan cole.origin: Born in Uganda, Officer Jonathan Payton "Black Jack" Cole was police officer with the NYPD in New York City. Called "Jack" (short for Jonathan) and nicknamed "Black Jack" because of his dark skin tone, Cole married Ruth and the pair had one son named Kevin Cole, but nicknamed "Kasper" because of his light skin tone. Around this same time, Black Jack also fathered another son, Nigel "Triage" Blacque, with an unidentified woman. Although he was revered by his son who considered him to be "the greatest cop who ever lived", Black Jack became involved in organized crime and joined the 66 Bridges Gang that he would later go on to lead. Black Jack was eventually arrested from some of his crimes when Kasper was a teenager. However, Black Jack has continued to run the 66 Bridge Gang from inside prison with the help of Triage.

jonathan darque.name: Jonathan Darque
jonathan darque.origin: The story begins with Jonathan Darque as chief executive officer of a mining company investigating new and cheap sources of energy. His investigations were opposed by environmental activists, who held demonstrations at his trial bore sites. His wife died in a car crash when attempting to evade the activists' blockade. Darque used his engineering skills to design a battle suit allowing him to become Magma. He then developed an underground criminal organization. Darque/Magma created a device he called the Long Range Sonic Strata Scanner (LRSSS), which enabled him to discover the epicentres of earthquakes before they erupted. He also used the machine to generate waves causing earthquakes; this enabled him to blackmail the Mayor of New York City. (At the publication time of this story, the historical Mayor was Ed Koch.) Magma held a press conference to reveal his plans. Spider-Man and Iron Man joined forces to drill down vertically to reach the source of the earthquake, where they discovered his hidden base. After Magma was defeated by Spider-Man and Iron Man in a battle on the surface, he escaped in a pod into the middle of the Atlantic Ocean. Spider-Man aimed the LRSSS at this location and Magma was engulfed by the resultant waves and he disappeared into the depths of the ocean. Magma was eventually arrested after several attempts to take over Stark Industries and some battles on the surface with Jim Rhodes in the Iron Man costume. Subsequently Darque was paid by Roxxon Oil Company and offered a job to lead a secret research laboratory located in the middle of a mountain, part of the Ridge-and-Valley Appalachians in Virginia. With the unwilling assistance of child prodigy Seth Hanks, Darque attempted to develop a new electron projector that would allow powerful beams to be directed at Earth from a satellite. Spider-Man saved his colleague, the child, and his mother from Magma's base and, accidentally, caused the collapse of the cave destroying the laboratory. His final fight was with the Human Torch in Brooklyn, where the Fantastic Four member's fire proved to be greater than the fire resistance of Magma's metal body. The fire melted Magma's equipment, and the asphalt under his feet, meaning that he was unable to continue the fight.
